graphql.query: Section label above the GraphQL query editor.
graphql.variables: Section label of the GraphQL variables; the value is JSON.
graphql.sendAsGraphql: Button that changes the request method to GRAPHQL.
graphql.prettify: Button that reformats the query. Short.
graphql.schema: Button and heading for the GraphQL schema: the list of types the endpoint offers.
graphql.notSent: {{method}} is an HTTP method name and stays in English.
graphql.searchPlaceholder: Placeholder of the schema search box. {{count}} is the number of types.
graphql.moreMatches: {{count}} is how many matching types are not shown.
graphql.noFields: Shown under a schema type that has no fields.
